limitations: Authored text fixtures, not human or synthesized audio; no physical-player use.
Thresholds selected on development only; raw unthresholded statistics added as diagnostics, not new test-selected thresholds.

All six hybrid development settings tied on selected criteria; conservative first-setting tie-break chose distance 0.3 and alpha 0.3. This small development set does not establish optimal hybrid configuration.
Shared parser interprets Artist in Play Artist E - Tishina as a qualifier. This case exposes parsing ambiguity, not only retrieval quality.
Twelve uncached latency probes are short English test phrases after warmup; RSS includes experiment Python dependencies but excludes Typesense.

The embedding cache was populated during an earlier incomplete run whose Typesense SDK readiness call failed before retrieval evaluation. No corpus or selection policy was changed in response to test results.
Intent classification still lacks learned slot extraction and robust negation/reported-speech handling.
